pairs: Væ pastoribus qui disperdunt et dilacerant gregem pascuæ meæ!
“Woe to the shepherds who scatter and tear apart the sheep of my pasture,
Ideo hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël ad pastores qui pascunt populum meum:
Because of this, thus says the Lord, the God of Israel,
to the shepherds who pasture my people:
and you have driven them away,
ecce ego visitabo super vos malitiam studiorum vestrorum,
and you have not visited them. Behold, I will visit upon you because of your evil pursuits,
Et ego congregabo reliquias gregis mei de omnibus terris ad quas ejecero eos illuc:
And I will gather together the remnant of my flock from the entire earth,
et convertam eos ad rura sua,
from the places to which I had cast them out.
And I will return them to their own fields.
And they will increase and be multiplied.
And I will raise up shepherds over them,
and they will no longer fear.
And no one among their number will be seeking more,
when I will raise up to David a righteous branch.
And he will exercise judgment and justice upon the earth.
In those days, Judah will be saved,
and Israel will live in confidence.
et hoc est nomen quod vocabunt eum:
And this is the name that they will call him:
Because of this, behold, the days are approaching,
when they will no longer say,
qui eduxit filios Israël de terra Ægypti,
who led the sons of Israel away from the land of Egypt,’
qui eduxit et adduxit semen domus Israël de terra aquilonis,
who led away and brought back the offspring of the house of Israel from the land of the north and from the entire earth,’
et de cunctis terris ad quas ejeceram eos illuc,
from the places to which I had cast them out.
And they will live in their own land.”
Contritum est cor meum in medio mei;
I have become like an inebriated man,
et quasi homo madidus a vino,
and like a man maddened by wine,
before the face of the Lord,
et a facie verborum sanctorum ejus.
and before the face of his holy words.
For the earth is full of adulterers!
quia a facie maledictionis luxit terra,
And the earth has mourned before the face of evil talk.
The plains of the desert have dried up,
and their course has become hazardous,
and their firmness has become uneven.”
Propheta namque et sacerdos polluti sunt,
“For both the prophet and the priest have become polluted,
et in domo mea inveni malum eorum,
and I have found their wickedness within my own house,
Idcirco via eorum erit quasi lubricum in tenebris:
For this reason, their way will be like a slippery path in the dark.
For they will be impelled forward,
and they will fall in it.
For I will bring evils over them,
in the year of their visitation,
Et in prophetis Samariæ vidi fatuitatem:
And I have seen the foolishness of the prophets of Samaria.
and they have deceived my people Israel.
Et in prophetis Jerusalem vidi similitudinem adulterantium,
And in the prophets of Jerusalem,
I have seen the likeness of adulterers and the path of falsehood.
And they have strengthened the hands of the wicked,
ut non converteretur unusquisque a malitia sua:
so that each one would not convert from his malice.
facti sunt mihi omnes ut Sodoma,
They have all become to me like Sodom,
and its inhabitants have become like Gomorrah.”
Propterea hæc dicit Dominus exercituum ad prophetas:
Because of this, thus says the Lord of hosts to the prophets: “Behold,
Ecce ego cibabo eos absinthio, et potabo eos felle:
I will feed them absinthe, and I will give them gall to drink.
a prophetis enim Jerusalem egressa est pollutio super omnem terram.
For from the prophets of Jerusalem corruption has gone forth over the entire earth.”
Thus says the Lord of hosts:
Nolite audire verba prophetarum qui prophetant vobis,
“Do not choose to listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you
They speak a vision from their own heart,
and not from the mouth of the Lord.
To those who blaspheme me, they say:
Locutus est Dominus: Pax erit vobis:
‘The Lord has said: You shall have peace.’
et omni qui ambulat in pravitate cordis sui dixerunt:
And to everyone who walks in the depravity of his own heart, they have said:
Quis enim affuit in consilio Domini,
For who has been present in the counsel of the Lord,
Behold, the whirlwind of the Lord’s indignation will go forth,
et tempestas erumpens super caput impiorum veniet.
and a tempest will break out; it will overwhelm the head of the impious.
The fury of the Lord will not return until it succeeds,
and until it completes the plan of his heart.
et usque dum compleat cogitationem cordis sui:
in novissimis diebus intelligetis consilium ejus.
I was not speaking to them,
If they had stood in my counsel,
et nota fecissent verba mea populo meo,
and if I had made my words known to my people,
avertissem utique eos a via sua mala,
certainly I would have turned them away from their evil ways
and from their most wicked plans.
Putasne Deus e vicino ego sum,
Do you not realize that I am a God close by,
and not a God far away?
If a man is hidden in concealed places,
Numquid non cælum et terram ego impleo?
Do I not fill up heaven and earth,
Audivi quæ dixerunt prophetæ prophetantes in nomine meo mendacium,
I have heard what the prophets have said, prophesying falsehoods in my name,
Usquequo istud est in corde prophetarum vaticinantium mendacium,
How long will this be in the heart of the prophets who predict what is false,
and who prophesy deceptions from their own heart?
Qui volunt facere ut obliviscatur populus meus nominis mei,
They want to cause my people to forget my name,
propter somnia eorum quæ narrat unusquisque ad proximum suum,
by means of their dreams, which each of them describes to his neighbor,
sicut obliti sunt patres eorum nominis mei propter Baal?
just as their fathers forgot my name for the sake of Baal.
The prophet who has had a dream,
And he who receives my word,
let him speak my word in truth.
For what has the chaff to do with the wheat,
Numquid non verba mea sunt quasi ignis,
Are not my words like a fire,
and like a hammer crushing rock?
Therefore, behold: I am against the prophets,
qui furantur verba mea unusquisque a proximo suo.
who steal my words, each one from his neighbor.
who take up their tongues and say:
Ecce ego ad prophetas somniantes mendacium,
et seduxerunt populum meum in mendacio suo
who explain and so seduce my people with their falsehoods and with their miracles,
though I did not send them,
They have offered nothing beneficial to this people,
Si igitur interrogaverit te populus iste,
Therefore, if this people, or a prophet,
or a priest questions you, saying,
‘What is the burden of the Lord?’
And certainly I will cast you away,
visitabo super virum illum et super domum ejus.
I will visit upon that man and upon his house.
And then you will speak in this way,
each one to his neighbor and to his brother:
And what has the Lord said?’
Et onus Domini ultra non memorabitur:
And the burden of the Lord will no longer be called to mind.
quia onus erit unicuique sermo suus,
For each one’s own word will be a burden.
For you have perverted the words of the living God,
And then you will speak in this way to the prophet:
And what has the Lord spoken?’
But if you say, ‘The burden of the Lord!’
then because of this, thus says the Lord:
Quia dixistis sermonem istum: Onus Domini,
Since you have spoken this word, ‘The burden of the Lord!’
et misi ad vos dicens: Nolite dicere:
though I sent to you telling you not to say:
propterea ecce ego tollam vos portans,
because of this, behold, I will take you away,
like a burden, and I will forsake you,
et civitatem quam dedi vobis et patribus vestris,
as well as the city that I gave to you and to your fathers,
et dabo vos in opprobrium sempiternum,
And I will give you over to an everlasting reproach
which shall never be wiped away into oblivion.”
